name: isClockwise
formula: =LAMBDA(vertices,LET(shapeArr, vertices, x, CHOOSECOLS(shapeArr, 1), y, CHOOSECOLS(shapeArr, 2), xShift, VSTACK(DROP(x, 1), TAKE(x, 1)), yShift, VSTACK(DROP(y, 1), TAKE(y, 1)), area, SUM(x * yShift - y * xShift), area < 0))
comment: To determine if a vertices of a polygon is in clockwise direction. Last update at 2024-07-05.
